name: circuitarium-mcp
description: A model-neutral electronics workbench with an unofficial, version-pinned CRUMB .cru file integration.
long_description: Inspect, validate, compare, inventory, export, and electrically review Unity-era CRUMB .cru files through 14 bounded MCP tools. Circuitarium is independent community interoperability work: it includes no CRUMB game code, assets, or circuit designs and does not claim live simulation or arbitrary editing.

workspace.title: Circuit workspace
workspace.description: Choose the smallest folder that contains the .cru files Circuitarium may inspect or generate.
